text_block_list.text:
I confront Фудзи Кисэки, and she finally
confesses
that she feels unworthy of
everyone's
expectations.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her fans' ardor—which borders on
obsession—is
becoming too much for her
to handle. She's afraid
she'll eventually
fail and disappoint everyone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки has given miracles to so many
people. I
assure her that she's an
incredible person.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки has given miracles to so many
people. I
assure her that she's an
incredible person.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I take Фудзи Кисэки to watch the younger
student
she inspired train. She helped
change her fellow
racer's life and
encouraged her to face her future.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My words renew her confidence, and
Fuji Kiseki
realizes she's not alone. She
believes we can
overcome anything
together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
